page.overview:
Who is Blaze?

Blaze is a young female Atrociraptor that first appeared in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory. She was one of the seven Atrociraptors created for Project Theropod Axis by Biosyn in their Sanctuary.

Blaze shares the same skin pattern as Red, with the sole exception of her color. She is grey, with cream underbelly and has grey stripes running down from the tip of her head to her hips. She has orange-yellow eyes.

Blaze is first seen when she and Princess were placed in a maze for training. They received the order of reaching a Compsognathus and then Blaze starts trying to reach it by running through the Maze. But before she could reach the target, Princess beat her and tackles the Compsognathus. When the two raptors were ordered to fight each other, Princess stood in an assertive, dominant position and becomes Blaze’s alpha. The two then work together to break free from the laser control system and kill Dr. Munnlerynn and Dr. Samuelson with the help of their pack.

Blaze attacked Rexy with her pack. She was winning until the Buck and Doe appeared, which attacked and fended the pack off.

entity.name: Blaze
entity.description:
Blaze is a character in the Mortal Kombat fighting game series.

Blaze made his debut as a background character in Mortal Kombat II and made his playable debut in Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance as a hidden character.

Blaze returned in Mortal Kombat: Armageddon, serving as a playable character and final boss.

First introduced in the series as a non-playable character seen in the background of the Pit II arena in Mortal Kombat II, Blaze was depicted as an elemental being from Outworld shrouded in flames. As his name and appearance suggests, he has control over fire, lava, heat, etc.
